import json

keys=['e80304576e38d38aec618a843b469085df4579f12be32b6c69f4bfb7de87395e','e823fb9b479007d4b5bce51d4dba96619296bf311b5b5e0a69360e205a87ec5e','e8278a0ab7de418d5a2819db39a5adb72507a23587605edf45bbdb4abe0f962c','e82c1978c71c3d8298c1ef0ed63ff51476d25f656e28aae20a0a08980f76664a','e82dab7a290c55e9305c34057ac1a5bb958fbcd6e09b771370c96b6d4944b453','e83a05187461932d0e24968427a2ca0412bbb3d024934baf7b7f76d1d10e57b8','e8409bc80e58994cc8bd7b6a7b9ff7801d46faf450d50e5b085b0335b4d62852','e8439bd0aeb513d16664e3eac14b4d4fc0c8ead18d6602d2abfbf1af17d286a5','e85982411310f6f86e0cf7817f88ea7d7b5302262c8ca3034e14bdcf6e308e0e','e85e4d885532dd2a1e0eb55069514b010ed3bee7ef2b98e4178a999ca3ef5e5e','e862dfab54b6168d1c660bcae2217d8344cf55b71137915ea6091a0651b55959','e873fb9bc746bc51474cf21c2a1ec7a82029168653fbd1ff6d14c2efb646e0fe','e882cc8d4ef163f98acffe86f7c50ff2ebff8d56a483ae9c1659a6713ea13b2d','e8959a83e245e295592ddf1bc4abd37fd204cdb87b7f1b16e20df58c52602477','e895fea0305d1be76d12a9fd52beca51c2a94cc217eaeef64bf8df6cf8ea16d5','e8a956f5c67e5c225b2807017ebc1be4dc546cc8f4cc9e49aabeb663803795c3','e8b5b2f244657526cd6a0524eff86771e2ff00a9a6b09800e59c31d4e67b0ddf','e8b90dff068deb7d3ab4e19d2c0b57ebccdcc880dc7c25fbf7baa6222974482f','e8bc936f6d6cb89e131fdddb68b357e4550d4ad593b0fd30247357dad567ca55']
issues={
0:'译文把“any diseases”限定为“衰老、虚弱、腐烂或传染性疾病”，但固定源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/corruptions/plague.lua 的 Cyst Burst 遍历并复制目标身上所有 subtype.disease 效果；同一固定版本还存在 Illness、Woeful Disease、Worm Rot、Ghoul Rot、Dire Plague 等疾病，因此该枚举错误缩小了可传播范围。',
5:'“this never happened”是对已发生事件的时间线抹除，译成“也不会发生”改成了未来时；固定源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/chronomancy/timeline-threading.lua:247-252 在消息出现前已移除效果、随后执行死亡，亦表明所指事件并非尚未发生。',
9:'“Dexterity instead of Strength”只作用于盾牌的属性加成伤害；固定源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/agility.lua:125-129 仅把 combat.dammod.str 转移到 combat.dammod.dex。译文称“代替力量决定盾牌伤害”，把适用范围扩大为全部盾牌伤害。',
12:'原文 bolts 是逐个敌对目标发射、由 projectile 实现的弹体；固定源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/psionic/discharge.lua:16-18、39-56 也明确使用 bolt/projectile。译文反复写成“灵能值球”，把弹体误成“灵能值”这一数值/资源概念。',
13:'译文遗漏了现有护盾持续时间会被延长这一机制，只写“强化”护盾；固定源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/celestial/dirge.lua 的回调同时累加 shield.power，并以 shield.dur = math.max(eff.dur, shield.dur) 延长持续时间。另将 defiance 译为“暴乱”也改变了“抗争/不屈”的语义。',
17:'这是“全屏混乱通知”的开关，而非“全屏混乱效果”；冻结上下文相邻说明明确写着禁用后不再收到 fullscreen notification，固定源码 game/modules/tome/dialogs/GameOptions.lua:397-404 仅切换 fullscreen_confusion 通知设置。译文遗漏“通知”，会把设置功能误解为混乱效果本身。'
}
ver=[]
for i,k in enumerate(keys):
 d={'revision_key':k,'verdict':'ISSUE' if i in issues else 'OK'}
 if i in issues:d['observation']=issues[i]
 ver.append(d)
out={'contract':'translation_contextual_v2','candidate_identity':cid,'verdicts':ver}
s=json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
assert s[0]=='{' and s[-1]=='}'
assert len(ver)==19
print(s)
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000});text(r.output)
